display_long_description:
Immersive Conducting

Control every aspect, from tempo to dynamics, using hand tracking for an authentic experience.

Virtual Concert Hall

Select works, view scores, and conduct realistically in an immersive virtual environment.

Advanced Musical Education

Exercises designed by experts to improve your conducting technique and skills.

Unique Educational Experience

Error Detection

Face real challenges by conducting works with intentional errors, identifying, and correcting them for effective learning.

Detailed Metrics

Analyze your progress with metrics at the end of each exercise, gaining a clear vision of your development.

We are developing a list of exercises designed for students to practice essential conducting techniques. These exercises include:

Maintaining stable tempo
Initial upbeat
Hand independence
Dynamic indications
Tutorials for conducting in 2/4, 4/4, initial upbeat, among others

Coming soon

MuseLab Singers (Coming Soon) A tool designed for singers, offering real-time feedback on intonation, rhythm, and expression.

MuseLab Jazz & More (Coming Soon) An immersive environment for jazz and other genre musicians, allowing practices with virtual accompaniment.

MuseLab Classical Musicians (Coming Soon) A tool for classical musicians that simulates full orchestra rehearsals with interactive feedback.

Login Information

For registered users: Please enter your email and password to access your account and continue your immersive music practice.
